history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration review the current practice of rehiring consultants under vendor contracts in terms of its compliance with existing guidance, cost-effectiveness and appropriateness.
history.administration_response: The Administration considers the recommendation to be implemented and requests its closure. The Office of Information and Communications Technology has discontinued the practice of transferring consultants to vendor contracts since the Board made its recommendation regarding the need for compliance with the existing guidance. The Office has confirmed that there was no instance in 2024 of consultants being transferred to vendor contracts. The Office will continue to follow the guidance.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Office of Information and Communications Technology has confirmed that there was no instance in 2024 of consultants being transferred to vendor contracts, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
